column1: # Spellings of a word: one row per source statement that a sequence of Han characters writes a word of
# data/vocab/words.tsv. Kept by hand; see docs/decisions/0004-word-spellings.md.
# tier: attested (a source states it) or observed (a person read an occurrence: a transcriber's 振り仮名).
# word_by: source (the source names the word) or reading (the source gives a reading, and the word is the one of that reading in words.tsv).
# basis and related are filled only where the source gives a reason: shape-confusion means the source says the spelling's form was confused with that of `related`.

# source unihan-kjapanese: Unicode Han Database (Unihan) 18.0.0, Unihan_Readings.txt, field kJapanese, whose data UAX #38 (revision 41) attributes to the 文字情報基盤 database of CITPC; Unicode-3.0 (https://www.unicode.org/license.txt); Copyright Unicode, Inc.; Unicode License v3. A reading list, Provisional in UAX #38: it does not name the word or the sense.
# source wiktionary-ja: Wiktionary 日本語版; CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://ja.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:著作権); Wiktionary 日本語版の執筆者 (revision in the locator). An open wiki, not a reviewed dictionary.

# source kanjipedia: 漢字ペディア, 日本漢字能力検定協会 (https://www.kanjipedia.jp/), accessed 2026-10-04, archived at the locator; quoted, all rights reserved by the publisher. A modern dictionary's web edition, giving no period or dated example for a sense.

# source chiebukuro-garan-2022: がらん, answer to 「「斗」はなんと読みますか？」, Yahoo!知恵袋, 2022-05-15 (https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q13261788763, archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261004062928/https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q13261788763). An anonymous forum answer chosen as best by the asker, citing no source.

# source honkoku-ruby: 振り仮名 of the みんなで翻刻 transcriptions, counted in data/vocab/ruby-spellings.tsv (みんなで翻刻（https://honkoku.org/）翻刻データ, CC BY-SA 4.0, revision be63dc2); crowd transcriptions with 1.5 errors or spelling inconsistencies per 100 characters in an expert audit, transcribers are asked to type modern forms, and the markup guide does not say whether a 振り仮名 is on the page. Only spellings that table attests in at least two documents are listed. The statement is the project's: the spelling with the reading the table keys it by, which the locator names; the forms as typed are in that table's `ruby` column. Readings without their dakuten are included for など (なと) and まで (まて) and left out for ばかり (はかり), which also spells the verb はかる (計り, 量り); すなわち and なお, typed in modern kana, count for すなはち and なほ, and so does なを, an Edo-period spelling of なほ. Spellings of another word with the same reading are left out (直 and 治 for なほす, 待 and 蟶 for まて, 最 and 尤 for the two words もつとも), and so is 他事 for ほか, whose three documents are copies of one text.
